Profile

About me

I’m Mustafa Jawwad, a Computer Science student building practical skills in digital marketing. I’m currently studying Python and digital marketing in my college’s skill development program, and working on a group capstone campaign project.

My strongest skill is designing social media posts that follow a brand’s color palette, so every post feels like it belongs to the same brand. My long-term goal is a career in AI and ML, and I see digital marketing and design as a creative skill that helps me understand how people respond to content, brands, and visuals. As a creative, I focus on clear ideas, consistent colors, and designs that are easy to read in a few seconds.

Featured brand

Fraggers Arena

The business

A gaming cafe with private PS5 and gaming simulator rooms and a bar.

Audience

Gamers and friend groups who want to play together without strangers around.

Tone of voice

Short, confident, and playful, with lines like “Play private.”

My creative direction

A black background with lime green highlights, oversized bold headlines, and clean information blocks. The black feels like a dark gaming room, the lime green gives it energy, and the minimal layout keeps the message clear. Every post keeps the same colors and type but uses a different layout so the feed feels varied, not repetitive.

Campaign

Five original posts

Post 01

Play private.

Concept. Introduces the brand’s main selling point in one line.

Thinking. The three columns (private rooms, PS5 and simulator, the bar) cover the whole offer at a glance. The crosshair adds a gaming touch without clutter.

Post 02

Bring your squad.

Concept. A booking-focused post aimed at friend groups.

Thinking. I inverted the colors with a full lime background so it stands out in the feed and breaks the pattern of the dark posts.

Post 03

Pick your game.

Concept. Shows the two main experiences side by side.

Thinking. The two cards, PS5 and SIM, let people compare quickly, and the headline underneath sums it up.

Post 04

Pause. Refuel.

Concept. Promotes the bar as the break between rounds.

Thinking. I used a calm, centered layout with lots of empty space, so it feels like a break from the other busy posts.

Post 05

Ready to play?

Concept. A call-to-action post that ends the campaign.

Thinking. The 1-2-3 steps make booking feel easy, and the lime button tells people exactly what to do next.
